tvShow.name: Women in Blue
tvShow.overview: In 1971, four women defy ultraconservative norms and join Mexico's first female police force—only to discover that it's a publicity stunt to distract the media from a serial killer. As the body count grows, they make a pact to bring the killer to justice.

episodes.name: María
episodes.overview: As a serial killer targeting women terrorizes the city, María, Valentina, Gabina, and Ángeles join the first female police force.

episodes.name: Paola
episodes.overview: María and the other Azules stumble upon a new victim of the Undresser and watch as a man they believe is innocent gets arrested.

episodes.name: Norma
episodes.overview: Dissatisfied with the detectives' conclusions, the Azules conduct their own investigation off the books.

episodes.name: Alma
episodes.overview: Another Undresser victim is found, confirming the Azules' suspicions. Their investigation points detectives to a new suspect.

episodes.name: Ángeles
episodes.overview: Romandía gets pulled into the investigation as the Azules uncover a clue that may reveal the Undresser's identity.

episodes.name: Laura
episodes.overview: The detectives take drastic measures to find answers. María seeks the help of someone who can offer new insight: a convicted serial killer.

episodes.name: Dora
episodes.overview: The Azules turn their attention to unsolved murders, hoping to find a connection to the Undresser.

episodes.name: Rosa
episodes.overview: María and Ángeles interview the adopted son of a woman named Rosa, who the Azules believe may have been the Undresser's first victim.

episodes.name: Gabina
episodes.overview: The Azules work with the detectives to stage a trap for the man they think is the Undresser—but things don't go as planned.

episodes.name: Valentina
episodes.overview: The Azules pull their resources together to try and save one of their own, putting the future of the female police force at risk.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set in 1970 and inspired by true events, “Women in Blue” tells the story of four women who defy the ultraconservative norms of the time and join Mexico’s first female police force, only to discover that their squad is a publicity stunt to distract the media from a brutal serial killer. As the body count grows, María, whose determination to catch the killer becomes an obsession, Gabina, whose father is a renowned cop, Ángeles, a brilliant fingerprint analyst, and Valentina, a young rebel, set up a secret investigation to achieve what no male officer has been able to do and bring the serial killer to justice.

episodes.name: Mauricio
episodes.overview: New lieutenant María and the Azules set their sights on investigating the murder of a college student.

episodes.name: Filiberto
episodes.overview: An unexpected clue links the first victim with a second, kicking off a theory about targeted attacks.

episodes.name: Quintanilla
episodes.overview: After interrogating the surviving student activists, it's clear one of them is hiding something.

episodes.name: Arizmendi
episodes.overview: Detectives are convinced they know who's behind the killing of dirty cops. The Azules aren't so sure.

episodes.name: Lozano
episodes.overview: When another detective goes missing, fear sets in. María's night out with her daughter takes a turn.

episodes.name: Gilberto
episodes.overview: Anti-police sentiment continues to grow in the wake of the Executioner's latest victims.

episodes.name: Gerardo
episodes.overview: An act of desperation forces Gerardo's hand—and threatens Gabina's friendship with Valentina.

episodes.name: Goyo
episodes.overview: The Azules race to connect the dots before the Executioner strikes again.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, now promoted to lieutenant, María finds herself torn between the rules she's sworn to uphold and a relentless pull toward the truth when the body of a student activist is discovered, and the Azules are pulled into an investigation that reaches back to the student massacre of 1968. Before they can make sense of what they've found, the body of a person connected to that brutal chapter of history is found, sending shock waves through the department. Someone is delivering justice straight to the police's door, and the Azules are the department's last hope of stopping the killer. As María, Valentina, Gabina and Ángeles fight battles both inside and outside the precinct, buried truths rise to the surface and they're forced to confront an uncomfortable question: in a system plagued with corruption, what is the cost of fighting for their ideals?
